data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 234.098m. The notes state adverse prior year development of GBP 5.3m (net) primarily relating to reserve deterioration in the Marine division, indicating a net strengthening of reserves (approximately 2.26% of opening gross claims). No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the notes or a gross claims development triangle, so the reported net adverse movement has been used as a fallback. The 2014 result was also materially impacted by aviation war losses (MH370, MH17 and the Tripoli Airport siege) which affected the year's underwriting performance.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities) at 31 Dec 2013 (prior year column). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was located; note 4 only states a net adverse prior year development of GBP 5.3m (net of reinsurance) and references Marine reserve development. Per instructions, the NET figure has been used as a fallback and flagged accordingly. No gross claims development triangle or a 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross column was found in the provided pages.
